verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents connecting Bitbucket Cloud to external CI/CD tools like Bamboo or Jenkins, and says third-party code reports can be viewed on the PR screen. That points to external CI results surfacing in the product, but the evidence never says external build statuses appear as status checks on commits or pull requests. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a build-status API or display on commits/PRs, use of external build statuses in merge checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
